task_title: Don't take inflated metrics at face value
output: {"concerns":["Growth Lead (unnamed startup, 2023-2024) claims 'Increased revenue 300%. Managed a $5M budget. Grew the team 10x.' with no baseline, timeframe detail, attribution/ownership, or company context.","Employer for the Growth Lead role is listed only as '(unnamed startup)' with no product, stage, or market detail.","Marketing Associate, Brightline (2021-2023) only states 'ran email campaigns'—no CV evidence of channel mix, experimentation, or growth systems.","Skills list SEO, paid ads, and 'data-driven growth' but job bullets do not show work in those areas."],"recommendation":"clarify","verify":["Who owned the 300% revenue result vs. contributed; baseline revenue, period, and primary levers.","What the $5M budget covered (channels, opex, headcount), approval authority, and ROI reporting.","Team size before/after the 10x claim, hiring vs. management scope, and direct reports.","Startup name, stage, business model, and Vance’s exact title/scope as Growth Lead.","Concrete SEO and paid-ads work (budgets, platforms, tests, outcomes) beyond the skills list.","Email campaign scope at Brightline (list size, lifecycle vs. blast, metrics, tools) and any broader growth work not on the CV."]}
